EntraIdP1.description: Conditional Access, authentication strengths, named locations

EntraIdGovernance.description: PIM and access reviews; an alternative to P2 for those two topics. Microsoft Learn (id-governance/licensing-fundamentals): the Governance products include the same PIM and access review capabilities as P2, and a Governance subscription can sit on a tenant that only has AAD_PREMIUM (P1) itself. A gate that tests PIM/access reviews only against P2 would wrongly mark such a tenant as unassessable.

IntunePlan1.description: Device compliance / enrollment for compliant-device CA. INTUNE_O365 (Mobile Device Management for Office 365) is deliberately NOT listed here: it is the limited MDM subset without Intune compliance policy, so it does not count as coverage for these checks.

DefenderForEndpoint.description: Device risk signals for CA. Only WINDEFATP is confirmed as a servicePlanName in the official export; 'MDATP', which was previously listed here, does not appear in it and was removed rather than kept as a guess.
